name: Options
description: Questions a product asks before it can be bought: a processor from a list, licences by the tick, power supplies by the number, a service priced by a formula (a fee plus a percentage of the product, a multiplier, the linked product's own price). An answer can be a service, a real product with its own stock — which then becomes a line of the order, so the warehouse and 1C see the goods — or a whole set of products to pick from with a search. A shared group is placed by display rules (a category with its subtree, a characteristic) and prices itself by formula rather than being re-priced per product.

settings.label: Offer a search box in a list longer than
settings.help: A dropdown of two hundred processors is not a choice, it is a scroll. Below this many answers the list is drawn as it is.

settings.label: Show what each answer adds beside it
settings.help: "+1 700 ₴" next to the answer, as on the owner's own configurator. Off leaves only the total, which is what a shop that prices by formula sometimes prefers.

settings.label: File answers: formats taken
settings.help: Comma-separated extensions, checked against what the BYTES say the file is rather than what it was called. A question can narrow this further on its own. Executable and script formats are refused whatever is typed here.

settings.label: File answers: largest file, KB
settings.help: A print shop takes a 40 MB layout; a shop asking for a logo does not. A question can set its own limit instead.

settings.label: File answers: keep an unbought file for, days
settings.help: A basket abandoned with a layout in it is the ordinary case, and without this the disk grows for ever. A file an order holds is never swept — it is kept for as long as the order is.
